answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, converted to a slow vesting stream, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. A vault of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lantern of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the nadir of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
